params.title: 2. Parameters Panel & 3. Training (Web Worker)
params.learningRateHint: Controls the step size when updating weights. Too low learns slowly; too high may overshoot and fail to converge.
params.epochsHint: How many times the network studies the entire dataset. More epochs lower error, but watch out for overfitting!
params.activationHint: Defines how a neuron transforms its weighted sum into output. Non-linear activations (ReLU, sigmoid, tanh) solve complex problems like XOR.
params.weightInitHint: How weights start before training. Breaking initial symmetry helps hidden neurons learn distinct roles.
params.biasHint: Shifts the activation function left or right, allowing the neuron to fire even when inputs are zero.
